args.query: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON p.customer_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND p.created_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(p.amount_cents) >= 10000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND t.status = 'open') ORDER BY spend DESC
SELECT customer_id, title, array_agg(id ORDER BY id) AS ids FROM tickets WHERE status = 'open' GROUP BY customer_id, title HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
